biocs.name: Unusual Process Spawned by Nginx
biocs.description: Detection of a process started by the Nginx binary that is not typical for ingress-nginx
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'nginx'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'nginx'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'bash'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'sh'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'sleep'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'curl'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'wget'

abiocs.name: Unusual Process Spawned by Nginx in Ingress Pod
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a non-standard process is spawned by Nginx in an ingress pod context
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'nginx'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name contains 'ingress-nginx'

xql_queries.name: Ingress Nginx Unusual Process Start
